Anchor native traffic lights to the actual titlebar superview bounds across zoom and resize; preserve fullscreen controls for custom-titlebar windows by removing only AutoHideToolbar from the proposed presentation options

Keep AppKit traffic lights visible during native fullscreen by moving the original buttons into the content view before AppKit removes the titlebar, restoring their original hierarchy on exit or failed entry, repositioning them through fullscreen resize and activation, and retaining native layout for windows without custom titlebars or valid initial button geometry; adapt retained pointer access and optional content-view handling to objc2 0.6; reposition fullscreen controls on key resign and activation, and include the content bounds origin in the top-left placement

Keep fullscreen native traffic lights inside a small top-left host row so AppKit restoring titlebar-local button coordinates cannot move them to the bottom of the full-height content view; anchor the host with orientation-aware autoresizing and remove it when restoring the original button hierarchy

Preserve configured custom-titlebar transparency throughout native fullscreen enter, exit and failure callbacks on macOS 15.3 and later, avoiding the opaque native band over the GPUI tabbar when the system menu reveals; add a policy regression and apply Rust 1.99 formatting to this source
